summary: Read-only platform comparison: existing Conduit onboarding already had separate detailed product reports, while the first pilot collapsed them. This rework restores product-specific depth, adds commercial and messaging guides, and makes audience decisions depend on product/proof evidence. The current platform has title/description/usage_note but no separate structured Agent context field; that remains a proposed integration contract.
remaining_risk: The standalone draft still needs human confirmation of necessary criteria; publicly named customer jobs do not establish commercial fit or willingness to buy.
original_pilot_summary: The cloned onboarding snapshot contains 12 documents, including one proposed hotel/resort ICP and no separate buyer-persona document. Its ICP contains meaningful jobs and some uncertainty handling, but cites internal document names rather than traceable public passages. It hard-excludes STR managers into a separate profile that is absent in this snapshot. The standalone draft instead starts with guest-operations buying situations, retains STR evidence, links public sources and separates fit, readiness and urgency. This is a qualitative comparison of saved outputs, not a controlled same-model benchmark.
